Specification: cf1s_folklore: A threshold-based Byzantine fault-tolerant one-step consensus protocol. N processes with at most T Byzantine and F crash faults (N > 3T, T >= F). Processes track sent (nSnt0/nSnt1) and received (nRcvd0/nRcvd1) messages via integer counters, with nSnt0F/nSnt1F tracking faulty sends. Actions: Faulty (crash with IF-THEN-ELSE counter updates), Propose (increment sent count, move to S0/S1), Receive (increment received count if below sent+faulty bound), Decide (4-way branch: D0, D1, U0, or U1 based on thresholds). Alternative initial states Init0/Init1. LTL properties: OneStep0_Ltl and OneStep1_Ltl.
IfThenElse: IF pc[i] = "V0" THEN nSnt0F' = nSnt0F + 1 ELSE nSnt0F' = nSnt0F
IF pc[i] = "V1" THEN nSnt0F' = nSnt1F + 1 ELSE nSnt1F' = nSnt1F
